devloop.note: This repo's .devloop/ is the ORIGIN from which the devloop plugin v0.1.0 was extracted. The generic core (personas, 7 commands, templates) now lives canonically in the plugin; the proof-capsule close ritual is the opt-in module (enabled here, which is why MONITOR.md keeps its capsule rule). In-repo copies are PRESERVED as-is and are NOT auto-synced. To source the slash commands from the plugin: `/plugin marketplace add /Users/aregee/Workspace/github.com/devloop` then `/plugin install devloop`, and you may then retire the global ~/.claude/commands/devloop-*.md copies.
